title: Final incident: the database disappeared
scenario: "P1: the portal returns 503 in production. Readiness is failing everywhere. Nobody deployed anything." — Incident commander
mission: Run the full incident: detect, diagnose under the method, restore through Terraform, write the post-mortem and give a two-minute English briefing.
objectives: Apply Observation → Hypothesis → Test → Evidence under pressure

prerequisites.notes: Sealed injection by a partner (GD-04 or a combination). Do not read docs/game-days.md first.

cost: Running platform cost. Plan the teardown right after.

steps.title: Stabilise the facts
steps.detail: What is failing, since when, where?

steps.title: Hypotheses
steps.detail: Write at least two before testing.

steps.title: Test from inside
steps.detail: Resolve the SQL name from a pod.

steps.title: Restore
steps.detail: Plan and apply the layer that drifted.

criteria.text: /readyz reports database: sql in dev and prod
terraform plan reports no changes for 10-foundation and 30-data
docs/postmortems/final-incident.md has the five sections and a timeline

expectedResult: Service restored, root cause found, prevention agreed.
recovery: If you are stuck for 15 minutes, write the current hypothesis table and ask for a hint — that is part of the method.
dont: Do not fix with portal clicks
Do not restart pods hoping it helps
hints: 503 on readiness = the API cannot reach its dependency.
Does the SQL name resolve to a private IP from inside the cluster?
A missing private DNS VNet link is drift on 10-foundation.

interview.question: Tell me about an incident you handled: what happened, how you found the cause and what you changed.
followUps: How would you detect this before customers?

debrief: Private DNS link removal makes pods resolve SQL publicly → blocked → readiness fails. Terraform restores the link; prevention: drift detection (C004), resource locks on DNS zones, an alert on readiness.

checker.plan: Read-only: kubectl get --raw service proxy /readyz, terraform plan -detailed-exitcode, post-mortem headings.

validation.notes: Checker not implemented yet; needs a running cluster.
